title: Spring potential energy
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as (1/2)mgR or an equivalent expression.

title: Velocity at point O
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as sqrt(3gR).

title: Trajectory equation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly stated as y² = 6Rx.

title: Energy conservation to B
description: Important: The solution must apply energy conservation between A and B, equating spring energy to kinetic energy at B.

title: Work-energy theorem B to O
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem from B to O, accounting for work done by gravity and the electric field.

title: Force analysis after O
description: Important: The solution must resolve forces after point O to find the constant accelerations in x and y directions.

title: Kinematic derivation
description: Optional: The trajectory equation should be correctly derived by eliminating time from the parametric x(t) and y(t) equations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize sign errors in work done by gravity or the electric field, or incorrect resolution of force directions.

title: Unit or expression error
description: Pitfall: Penalize incorrect algebraic manipulation leading to a wrong expression for velocity or trajectory, or missing the 'm' in the energy answer.
